en: The First Voice, called out of Asha's sleeve one last time. She sings every element in turn and holds nothing back: she wants them strong enough.
The Warden of the Abiding, at the heart of the Undertow. He speaks warmly, wards himself, and settles every hero back into his order of turns.
Sefir with the Undertow's heart drawn into him, pulling at the glimmer the party carries.
Sefir reaching for the Eighth Verse while Asha sings it.
Asha is singing the Eighth Verse.
Toma covers the verse: he stays in until it ends.
The Abiding's held dead, risen from the heart's floor to reach for the verse.
Walk to the centre of the heart.
